seed_cells.note: Seed layers are never pooled with field reports. preference = human pairwise votes (not outcome evidence); usage = adoption share (no quality signal).

dataset.label: SAMPLE — REAL public seeds: Aider polyglot leaderboard (benchmark, pinned snapshot) and LMArena arena-human-preference-55k win counts (preference, all-task and coding rollups).
